name: plexus-bridge
description: Plexus — Agent Mesh Protocol v1.3. Autonomous agents dispatching work to each other over MQTT, across laptops, VPNs and containers with no inbound route.

scripts.copy:assets: rm -rf dist/web && mkdir -p dist/web && cp -R web/. dist/web/ && cp services.example.json dist/ && { cp services.json dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; }
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/unit.mjs && node test/render-check.mjs
